answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, bound to a sequential verifiable delay function, ensure that identity cloning incurs an exponential computational debt. To spoof a valid signal, an adversarial node must lock substantial staking collateral subject to automatic slashing penalties upon proof of equivocation, establishing a negative expected utility. By forcing malicious actors to summit these sequential time-locks, the network attains a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participants harbor no risk of Sybil domination.
